newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian Duma sets Jan 24 date for budget debate.
newsitem.headline: Russian Duma sets Jan 24 date for budget debate.

text.p: The State Duma lower house of parliament will hold the fourth and final reading of the 1997 budget on January 24, speaker Gennady Seleznyov said on Tuesday.
Deputies approved the third reading of the budget on December 28 by 243 votes to 117.
The budget envisages a deficit of 3.5 percent of gross domestic product. Revenues will be 434.4 trillion roubles and expenditure 529.8 trillion roubles.
If the Duma, dominated by communists and their allies, approves the budget, it must then be approved by the upper house of parliament and signed into law by President Boris Yeltsin.
